answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the ember accrues. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest quartz a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the mesa behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal ysjjd.
